conditions: Applies to compiled Core IF with its forward reference resolved.
limitations: The entry leaves interpretation semantics undefined and gives THEN and ELSE as examples of resolving the reference.

triggers: Evidence correction, scope change, or contrary primary material.

statement: The dated Forth 2012 draft describes Core IF as putting the location of an unresolved forward reference on the control-flow stack during compilation. Its run-time behavior consumes a stack value and branches to the resolved destination when every bit of that value is zero.
